senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; כָּרַךְ)bundle, roll, volume. Y. Sabb. XV, 15ᶜ ת׳ של ברכות a volume containing formulas of benedictions; Treat. Sof’rim XV, 4 (not שטרות); (Tosef. Sabb. XIII (XV), 4 טוֹמוֹס).
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Bava Metzia 1:8">B. Mets. I, 8</cite> <he>ת׳ של שטרות</he> a bundle of documents, expl.
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 20b:8">ib. 20ᵇ</cite> <he>שלשה כרוכין וכ׳</he> three documents rolled up together, contrad. to <cite ref="A00258"><he>אגודה</he></cite> tied together; a. e.

senses.gloss: wrap, cloak, esp. pl. תַּכְרִיכִים, תַּכְרִיכִין dead man’s wrap, shroud. Kit IX, 4 תַּכְרִיכֵי המת וכ׳ the dead man’s garments … are not subject to the laws concerning mixed material. Y. ib. IX, 32ᵇ top אל תרבו עלי ת׳ do not bury me with many garments; Y. Keth. XII, 35ᵃ top: Gen. R. s. 100.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Maaser Sheni 5:12">Maas. Sh. V, 12</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Deuteronomy 26:14">Deut. XXVI, 14</cite>) <he>לא לקחתי … ות׳ למת</he> I did not buy a coffin or shrouds with it &c.; <cite ref="Sifrei Devarim 303:17">Sifré Deut. 303</cite>; a. e.
